citations.document_title: On-orbit sleep problems of astronauts and countermeasures
citations.summary: The review concludes that too little sleep and poorer sleep quality are common in spaceflight. It lists as main causes the confined cabin, changes to the work-rest schedule, poorly arranged work, impaired sleep regulation, circadian desynchrony and physical or psychological discomfort, and notes that the effect of sleep loss on performance is complex and may depend on the type of task.
